name: Flipkart Seller
shortInfo: Flipkart Seller Platform is an e-commerce platform that allows sellers to register and manage various aspects of their businesses
brief: Get access to Seller Insights Report, Commission Invoice Transaction Details Report and much more through this Flipkart Seller connector.
about: Flipkart Seller Connector enables streaming relevant Flipkart Seller performance data into a user determined data warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
availableData:
[Commission Invoice Transaction Details](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/flipkart-seller/pipelines/commission-invoice-transaction-details.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve Commission Invoice Transaction Details Report.

[MP Fee Rebate Transactions](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/flipkart-seller/pipelines/mp-fee-rebate-transactions.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve MP Fee Rebate Transactions Report.

[Seller Insights](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/flipkart-seller/pipelines/seller-insights.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve Seller Insights Report.
